SCRIPT_MUTATIONS:
web:
    if: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' && (!inputs.package || inputs.package == 'miniapp') }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 100

web:
    if: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' && (!inputs.package || inputs.package == 'miniapp') }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 60
the weekly battery's web job holds the whole Mini App's sweep at 100 minutes; set back to 60 it is cut before its report is written and its leg reads VOID (SPEC-379 R1, R2)
the mutation-web job holds a release's sweep of most of the Mini App at 100 minutes; set back to 60 it is cut before its report is written and its leg reads VOID (SPEC-379 R1, R2)

web:
    if: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' && (!inputs.package || inputs.package == 'miniapp') }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 100

web:
    if: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' && (!inputs.package || inputs.package == 'miniapp') }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 121
the weekly battery's web job's bound stays at most 120, twice the projected whole sweep rounded down to the ten, so a hung test ends within two hours (SPEC-379 R2)
the mutation-web job's bound stays at most 120, twice the projected whole sweep rounded down to the ten, so a hung test ends within two hours (SPEC-379 R2)

web:
    if: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' && (!inputs.package || inputs.package == 'miniapp') }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 100
the weekly battery's web job declares its bound; with no timeout-minutes it takes the hosted job's own limit, far above the band (SPEC-379 R2)
the mutation-web job declares its bound; with no timeout-minutes it takes the hosted job's own limit, far above the band (SPEC-379 R2)
